CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  June 08, 2021
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  JENNIFER STARK
  MAYOR

  COREY CALAYCAY  JED LEANO  SAL MEDINA  ED REECE

Pursuant to the local emergency concerning the COVID-19 virus declared by
the City Council of the City of Claremont on March 19, 2020, the Los Angeles
County Department of Health's "Safer at Home Order" issued March 19, 2020,
and Executive Order N-29-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March
18, 2020, the following protocols will apply to public participation for the
duration of the emergency:

Members of the public will not be permitted to be physically present at meetings. To allow for public
participation, the City Council will conduct its meeting through Zoom Video Communications. To
participate in the meeting from the comfort of your own home or office, download Zoom on any phone or
computer device and copy and paste the following link into your browser to access and participate in the
live City Council meeting at 6:30 p.m.: https://zoom.us/j/256208090 or to only listen from the phone dial
(213)338-8477,  Webinar  ID:  256 208 090.  For  assistance,  please  call  (909)399-5461 or
(909)399-5463.

Members of the public who wish to address the City Council on any matter listed on the agenda or a
subject matter within the jurisdiction of the City Council may utilize the following methods. The Council
requests, but does not require, the public speakers to identify themselves.

OPTION 1: LIVE COMMENTS - Through Zoom, someone wishing to speak may virtually "raise your
hand". Wait to be called upon by the City Clerk, and then you may provide verbal comments for up to 4
minutes.

OPTION 2: E-MAIL - Public comments may be sent via email to the City Clerk’s office at
sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us or jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. All emails received before 3:00 p.m.,
will be distributed to the City Council, imaged into the City’s document archive system, and read into the
record (up to 4 minutes).
 Page 2  City Council Agenda  June 8, 2021

OPTION 3: MAIL - Public comments may be mailed to Claremont City Hall, Attn: City Clerk’s Office, PO
Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. All comments received via mail will be distributed to the City Council,
imaged into the City’s document archive system, and read into the record (up to 4 minutes).

OPTION 4: TELEPHONICALLY - Members of the public wanting to address the City Council
telephonically are requested to inform the Claremont City Clerk's office no later than 3:00 p.m. on the
day of the meeting.  The Claremont City Clerk's office can be reached at (909) 399-5461, (909)
399-5463, sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, or jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. You will be called during
consideration of the item you are interested in and given up to 4 minutes to speak.

The meeting will not be live streamed through Granicus as the meeting will be live streamed through
Zoom instead. The recorded meeting will be uploaded and saved as a record.

CALL TO ORDER THE MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

MOMENT OF SILENCE

ROLL CALL

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CEREMONIAL MATTERS, PRESENTATIONS, AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

MAYOR AND COUNCIL

Council Items

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City  website :
https://www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointment
s.

CITY MANAGER REPORT

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons in the audience who wish to comment on items
that ARE NOT LISTED ON THIS AGENDA, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council.
Members of the audience will later have the opportunity to address the City Council regarding ALL
OTHER ITEMS ON THE AGENDA at the time the Council considers those items.

At this time the Council will take public comment for 30 minutes. Public Comment will resume later
in the meeting if there are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the
30-minute time limit.
 Page 3  City Council Agenda  June 8, 2021

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

The Council requests, but does not require, speakers to identify themselves. When you come up
to speak, please state your name unless you wish to remain anonymous. Each speaker will be
allowed four (4) continuous minutes.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the consent calendar are considered to be routine. The City Council or one or
more Commissions and/or Committees have previously considered most of the items on the
consent calendar. The Council may act on these items by one motion following public comment.

Only Councilmembers may pull an item from the consent calendar for discussion.

The City Council will waive reading of resolutions and ordinances. Each resolution and ordinance
will be numbered following Council approval.

Now is the time for those in the audience to comment on the consent calendar. Each speaker will
be allowed four (4) continuous minutes to comment on items on the consent calendar.
1.  RESIGNATION OF PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE MEMBER KAREN NEIUBER
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council accept with regret the resignation of
  Karen Neiuber from the Public Art Committee.
  Attachment(s):  Resignation Letter

2.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE CITY WARRANT REGISTER
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ALLOWING
  CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID, dated May 27, 2021.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated May 27, 2021

3.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF MAY 25, 2021 (SPECIAL AND REGULAR)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council approve and file the special and
  regular City Council meeting minutes of May 25, 2021.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Special Meeting Minutes of May 25, 2021
  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of May 25, 2021
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  June 8, 2021

4.  CITYWIDE USER FEE RATE INCREASE OF 3.60 PERCENT BASED UPON THE
  CONSUMER PRICE INDEX (CPI) FROM APRIL 2020 TO APRIL 2021 - EFFECTIVE JULY
  1, 2021
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the 2021 Citywide
  User Fee Schedule, incorporating a CPI increase of 3.60 percent, effective
  July 1, 2021.
  Attachment(s):  Proposed Citywide User Fee Schedule
  Fully Burdened Hourly Staffing Rates

5.  SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCES AMENDING CLAREMONT
  MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 8.08.130, 8.21.010, AND 13.08.010 TO ALLOW FUTURE
  SANITATION AND SEWER FEE SCHEDULES TO BE ADOPTED BY RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL (FUNDING SOURCE: SANITATION FUND AND SEWER FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  A. Waive further reading and adopt AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING A
  NEW  SCHEDULE  OF  FEES  FOR SERVICES  AND  FACILITIES
  FURNISHED BY THE CITY IN CONNECTION WITH ITS SANITARY SEWER
  SYSTEM,  ADOPTING  A  FORMULA  FOR  AUTOMATIC  ANNUAL
  ADJUSTMENTS IN SEWER FEE SCHEDULES THROUGH 2026 TO
  REFLECT CHANGES IN THE CONSUMER PRICE INDEX, AND AMENDING
  SECTION 13.08.010 OF THE CLAREMONT MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW
  SEWER FEE SCHEDULES TO BE ADOPTED BY RESOLUTION IN THE
  FUTURE; and
  B. Waive further reading and adopt AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING A
  NEW SCHEDULE OF FEES FOR: (1) THE COLLECTION AND DISPOSAL
  OF REFUSE, GARBAGE, AND WASTE MATTER; (2) THE COLLECTION OF
  RECYCLABLE MATERIAL; AND (3) STREET SWEEPING WITHIN THE
  CITY OF CLAREMONT, ADOPTING A FORMULA FOR AUTOMATIC
  ANNUAL ADJUSTMENTS IN THESE FEE SCHEDULES TO REFLECT
  CHANGES IN THE CONSUMER PRICE INDEX, AND AMENDING
  SECTIONS 8.08.130 AND 8.21.010 OF THE CLAREMONT MUNICIPAL
  CODE TO ALLOW THESE FEE SCHEDULES TO BE ADOPTED BY
  RESOLUTION IN THE FUTURE.
  Attachment(s):  Sewer Rate Ordinance
  Sanitation Rate Ordinance
 Page 5  City Council Agenda  June 8, 2021

6.  AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR PARK RESTROOM  CUSTODIAL  SERVICES  (FUNDING
  SOURCE: LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING DISTRICT FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council authorize the City Manager to
  execute a three-year contract with two optional one-year extensions with
  Commercial Building Management in an amount not to exceed $79,602 per
  year and authorize a contingency of $4,398, for a total of $84,000 annually
  for custodial services for all City-owned park restrooms.
7.  AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR SENIOR CASE MANAGEMENT SERVICES  (FUNDING
  SOURCE: COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council award a contract to AgingNext for
  senior case management services in the amount of $32,140 for a one-year
  term, with two optional additional one-year terms in the amounts of up to
  $33,104 and $34,097 annually.
8.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE SUBMITTAL OF 2020-21
  TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT ARTICLE 4 AND STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE
  CLAIM FORMS TO RECEIVE TRANSIT CAPITAL AND OPERATING FUNDS TO FUND THE
  CLAREMONT  DIAL-A-RIDE  SERVICE  (FUNDING  SOURCE: TRANSPORTATION
  DEVELOPMENT ACT AND STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE FUNDS)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING
  THE SUBMITTAL OF THE 2020-21 TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT
  ACT ARTICLE 4 AND STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE CLAIM FORMS TO
  RECEIVE CAPITAL AND OPERATING FUNDS TO FUND THE DIAL-A-RIDE
  SERVICE.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution

9.  APPROVAL OF FINAL TRACT MAP NO. 82123 SUBDIVIDING 4.96 ACRES FOR
  RESIDENTIAL  TOWNHOME  CONDOMINIUM PURPOSES AT 511 COLBY CIRCLE.
  APPLICANT - CLAREMONT 96 LLC
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OR THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE
  FINAL TRACT MAP NO. 82123 and the associated Subdivision Improvement
  Agreement, Deferred Improvement Agreement, and Agreement to Defer
  Completion of Certain Conditions.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution
  Tract Map No. 82123
  7/21/20 Planning Commission Minutes Excerpt
  Planning Commission Resolution 2020-12
 Page 6  City Council Agenda  June 8, 2021

PUBLIC HEARINGS
Public Hearings will not begin before 7:00 p.m. Each speaker providing public comment will be
allowed four (4) continuous minutes to speak, which cannot be delegated.
10. APPROVAL OF THE DISTRICT ENGINEER'S REPORT AND ADOPTION OF THE 2021-22
  LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING DISTRICT ANNUAL ASSESSMENT OF $188.00 PER
  ASSESSMENT UNIT
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  A. Open the public hearing, receive public comment, and close the public
  hearing;
  B. Accept the Engineer's Report prepared by Willdan Financial Services;
  and
  C. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT,  CALIFORNIA,  CONFIRMING  A  DIAGRAM  AND
  ASSESSMENT, AND LEVYING THE ASSESSMENT FOR THE 2021/22
  FISCAL YEAR IN CONNECTION WITH LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING
  DISTRICT NO. LL001 PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF PART 2 OF
  DIVISION 15 OF THE CALIFORNIA STREETS AND HIGHWAY CODE.
  Attachment(s):  Engineer's Report
  Resolution
  04-07-21 Community and Human Services Commission Minutes

11. ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING NEW FEES FOR VARIOUS CITY
  PROGRAMS AND SERVICES AND AUTOMATIC ANNUAL COST OF LIVING INCREASES
  EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2021
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING A
  SCHEDULE OF NEW FEES FOR VARIOUS CITY PROGRAMS AND
  SERVICES AND AUTOMATIC ANNUAL COST OF LIVING INCREASES.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution to Adopt Schedule of New Fees

ORDINANCES - None
 Page 7  City Council Agenda  June 8, 2021

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEM
12. ADOPTION OF THE 2021-22 PROPOSED OPERATING AND CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT
  PROGRAM BUDGET, ESTABLISHMENT OF THE 2021-22 APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT AND
  ADOPTION OF A STREET CUT MORATORIUM POLICY
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  A. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING THE 2021-2022 BUDGET AND
  AUTHORIZING  EXPENDITURES  AND  APPROPRIATIONS RELATED
  THERETO;
  B. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, DETERMINING AND ESTABLISHING AN
  APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22; and
  C. Adopt the proposed Street Cut Moratorium Policy.

CONTINUED PUBLIC COMMENT
This time is reserved for those persons who were unable to speak earlier in the agenda because
of the 30-minute time restriction.

COMMISSIONS

  - Planning Commission (1 Vacancy)
  - Architectural Commission (2 Upcoming Vacancies)
  - Community and Human Services Commission (1 Upcoming Vacancy)
  - Traffic and Transportation Commission (1 Upcoming Vacancy)

ADJOURNMENT

THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL WILL BE HELD ON
JUNE 22, 2021, AT 6:30 P.M., VIA ZOOM.

A LOOK AHEAD – Upcoming Meetings and Tentative Agenda Items

  - Resolution Placing Liens on Delinquent Sanitation Accounts
  - Village South Specific Plan, General Plan Amendment, Zone Change and Draft EIR

MATERIALS RELATED TO AN ITEM ON THIS AGENDA, AND SUBMITTED TO THE CITY COUNCIL
AFTER PUBLICATION OF THE AGENDA, ARE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC IN THE CITY CLERK’S
OFFICE AT 207 HARVARD AVENUE, CLAREMONT, MONDAY THROUGH THURSDAY, 7 AM – 6
PM. SUBJECT MATERIALS WILL BE MADE AVAILABLE ON THE CITY WEBSITE AS SOON AS
POSSIBLE - www.ci.claremont.ca.us. For more information, please call the City Clerk’s Office at
909-399-5461.
 Page 8  City Council Agenda  June 8, 2021

IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT 0F 1990, THIS AGENDA WILL
BE MADE AVAILABLE IN APPROPRIATE ALTERNATIVE FORMATS TO PERSONS WITH
DISABILITIES. ANY PERSON WITH A DISABILITY WHO REQUIRES A MODIFICATION OR
ACCOMMODATION IN ORDER TO PARTICIPATE IN A CITY MEETING SHOULD CONTACT THE
CITY CLERK AT 909-399-5461 “VOICE” OR 1-800-735-2929 “TT/TTY” AT LEAST THREE (3)
WORKING DAYS PRIOR TO THE MEETING, IF POSSIBLE.

I, SHELLEY DESAUTELS, CITY CLERK OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, HEREBY
CERTIFY UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY THAT THE FOREGOING AGENDA WAS POSTED AT
CLAREMONT CITY HALL, 207 HARVARD AVENUE, ON JUNE 3, 2021, PURSUANT TO
GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54954.2.

POST THROUGH: June 9, 2021
